| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path | falsified |

components, the design-versus-code placement and the authority

The core rule, with the test that a design is too imperative and too
coupled when a reader has to inspect orchestration to learn what the
system means, is stated once in
[SPEC_METHOD §2 Realisation shape](SPEC_METHOD.md#realisation-shape),
scoped to boundaries this profile governs; every rule below refines it
(P1, P6; rc.2 #3-core-rule).

predicate.statement: The core rule is owned once by SPEC_METHOD §2 Realisation shape; all following design rules refine it within adopted scope. A design is too imperative and coupled when understanding system meaning requires inspecting orchestration.
predicate.uncertainty: The complete owning rule is not supplied.

conditions: Source-declared consequences and consumer uses; not proofs performed here.

grounding.quote:
Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not (P2, P6).

predicate.statement: Keep foundation commitments, imported family premises, adopted instance premises and added policy choices distinct. Consumers apply without extending the owner's decisions. ASSURANCE applies taxonomy, IACS, three views, accepted Ontology and decision completeness through the declared binding; UX refines typing/realisation for UX modules, including making ingress parsing obligatory at six seams; ACTIVATION Intake consumes frame invariants/affected sets, admission relations and computational dispositions; EXECUTIVE_BASELINE consumes frame conservation and material capability selection; ODD keeps graph ownership and specialises admission; TICKETS owns recurrence thresholds/order; FOUNDATIONS owns shared machinery; PRODUCT_DEFINITION owns adoption and constitutional subordination; IDENTITY retains override law. Governance/strategy, optimisation, post-ticket review and interface rules have no other-member consumer in the listed map; their references to external owners do not reverse that direction.
predicate.uncertainty: The exact external loci are source references, not acquired endpoint contents.

conditions: As the foundation-to-law table describes Prime, IACS and computational realisation rules.

grounding.quote: a revision re-derives the whole set and reruns its gates over all of it

predicate.statement: A top-level unit is Prime-conformant only as a projection of accepted Prime atoms governing declared domains without added semantic authority. Whole-family contraction preserves root authority and cannot succeed by increasing authority centres, truth surfaces or review burden. A schema/typed boundary declares the smallest accepted-Ontology carrier set needed for functionality/authority flow; other shapes remain subordinate unless passing the Promotion Test, and extra boundaries are design debt. IACS revision rederives and regates the whole set. Material algorithmic obligations receive semantic and realisation dispositions; code similarity supplies only a commonisation candidate, materially different law requires separation, and required outcomes need a realisation route. Reuse does not newly own an accepted relation.
predicate.uncertainty: Detailed Prime rules, promotion grounds and algorithmic-disposition values are referenced later and not supplied.

conditions: Before promotion or design-method closure for a new or semantically changed boundary.
exceptions: An unchanged realization_refactor may reuse its verdict with proof of no delta under reuse law.

grounding.quote: without both verdicts `accepted` a new or semantically changed boundary is not promoted, published or closed

predicate.statement: Domain, sequence and state views are distinct fidelity-checked projections of accepted Ontology, not peer truth. Evaluate every applicable axiom across them before promotion/closure, mapping each verdict once to the core; non-application satisfies only its declared disjunction and never counts as met. Produced design packs remain candidates; Ontology/design acceptance belongs to the design authority and is distinct from assessment. A mandatory nonsatisfied result or gap cannot yield satisfied conjunction. Both owner verdicts must be accepted before promotion/publication/closure; co-evolved implementation remains provisional evidence until gate acceptance.
predicate.uncertainty: Detailed gate, view and verdict definitions are outside these excerpts.

conditions: As described in the foundation-to-law table's realisation, review and adoption rows.
exceptions: Strategy may be published when part of ratified responsibility.
Identity defaults remain overridable by the identity owner.

grounding.quote: a boundary that governs, observes or evaluates another actor publishes state, boundary and admissible routes, not strategy, unless strategy is part of its ratified responsibility
partial adoption names the adopted boundary and rule family and claims no completion whose evidence it skipped

predicate.statement: Immutable typed values are preferred; semantic functions should be total or as close as language/problem permit; effects should be explicit at edges, controllers should not hide semantic law, and coupling should reduce meaning-inventing loci. Governance publishes state/boundaries/admissible routes within its authority. Cleanup is lawful only if boundary-local and neutral in behaviour, authority, visibility and effect; cross-boundary opportunities become owner repricing inputs. Credible recurrence triggers review, never automatic merger. Before a closure claim, bounded review reconstructs its exact function, reusing evidence only lawfully; falsifying issues/applicable hard stops block the claim, while outside-claim discoveries are repricing inputs. Interface families each have one authoritative source; preserving an old authority behind a proxy is bridge debt, with retained compatibility requiring its own authority/proof. Review checks need claim evidence; prompt clauses need provenance and evidence of caused/prevented behaviour. Authorized adoption applies consistently to named scope; completion of new/materially changed boundaries needs Ontology and evidence. Consumer-bound ABG-role runtime generators/validators/normalizers are only overridable defaults for that role's own surfaces.
predicate.uncertainty: Detailed later rule exceptions, thresholds, checklists and runtime default surfaces are not supplied.

conditions: Profile used inside a graph-execution-governed product.

grounding.quote:
If a deterministic module appears to own what work is next, what target is
being moved to, what closes the traversal or what graph function is being
performed, the boundary should be repriced against the graph-execution
profile before claiming design-method closure. In such products the module
boundary is a realisation cut inside the graph program; it is not the
program (P6).

predicate.statement: Review first asks whether the boundary is operative graph traversal. If a deterministic module appears to own next work, target movement, traversal closure or the performed graph function, the boundary should be repriced against graph-execution before a design-method closure claim.
predicate.uncertainty: The repricing recommendation retains should force.

conditions: Every change; source-coherence provisions additionally apply to projections and queries.
exceptions: Same-name/different-shape carrier divergence is lawful only under explicit migration design.

grounding.quote:
reconstructed catalogue, ownership,
route, status or closure truth is structurally compared against the
admitted source carrier before publication; same-name but different-shape
carriers fail closed unless an explicit migration design makes the
divergence lawful; and negative tests cover structural drift, not only
missing source truth.

predicate.statement: A change adds no truth surfaces; seam-closure work should reduce existing rivals/duplicates. Each semantic boundary has one authoritative carrier/contract, with no controller reconstruction of admitted truth, silent downstream rebuilding from raw artifacts, or trust in raw/open payload past ingress. Removal of the authoritative carrier must fail closed; silent reconstruction means an unclosed seam. Projections name their admitted source and compare reconstructed catalogue/ownership/route/status/closure truth structurally before publication. Negative tests cover structural drift as well as missing source.

conditions: Each profile-governed change.

grounding.quote:
Progress is fewer, sharper carrier families, less duplicate
authority and less boundary inflation; not one more wrapper layer, one more
branch-local peer type, or one more public record that only mirrors
payload detail.

predicate.statement: Each change should consolidate the slice into its few genuine identity-bearing families, declaring IACS first and keeping payloads subordinate by default. Avoid fragment classes/interfaces/results created only for typing, serialization or convenience extraction. Progress is fewer sharper families, reduced duplicate authority and boundary inflation; wrappers, branch-local peer types and payload-mirroring public records alone do not establish it.
predicate.uncertainty: The recommendation's should force is retained.

grounding.quote:
The rule is the same: proof
first, enforcement second.

Not lawful seam closure: repeated parsing of the same
loose payload in several modules; `from_dict(...).to_dict()` or equivalent
round-trip ceremony that preserves the same open authority; loaders that
merely relabel stored JSON or map data without validating it; semantic
kernels that continue to inspect open payload fragments directly.

predicate.statement: Parse/validate/construct, explicitly admit and narrow, then enforce the proved shape. Foreign/dynamic/weakly typed data is lawful only at ingress and immediately collapses into local truth before semantic transforms. Relabelling open payloads, typed envelopes retaining open authority, casts/unchecked assertions/dynamic mutation as fake closure, repeated loose parsing, authority-preserving round trips, unvalidated JSON/map relabelling and direct semantic-kernel inspection of fragments are not lawful closure.

conditions: Projects adopting this profile.
exceptions: Materially necessary mutable carrier state under the owning Immutable carriers rule, with its required justification.
The explicit-failure-carrier preference applies only where practical.

grounding.quote:
Both lists bind. A project that adopts this profile prefers the first
and avoids the second as an obligation of the profile, not as a
description of practice: a realisation that takes an avoided shape, or
forgoes a preferred one, does not conform unless a rule of this profile
permits that departure and the realisation records the justification the
rule requires. The permitted departures are those the owning rules state:
mutable carrier state where it is materially necessary, under §10
[Immutable carriers](#immutable-carriers), and the failure-carrier
preference only where practical. Convenience permits no departure (P6,
P2; the predecessor's "must prefer" and "must avoid", read with the
necessity exception of its immutable carrier rule).

predicate.statement: Binding preferences are immutable carriers over shared mutable objects, closed typed carriers over open dictionaries/string protocols, one-time ingress parsing/admission, explicit returns over hidden mutation, explicit failures over ambient exception control where practical, and small-transform composition over long controllers. Binding avoidances are giant mutable workspace objects, orchestration-owned semantic law, global/registry/service-state read-write coupling, typed envelopes over open truth, dynamic semantic-centre mutation, helpers combining meaning decisions and writes, and proxies preserving old authority. Departure is nonconformant unless expressly permitted by an owning rule and justified as that rule requires; convenience supplies no exception.
predicate.uncertainty: The full immutable-carrier necessity rule is not supplied.

conditions: Repository-authored code inside the adopted Python boundary.
exceptions: Any, cast(...) and # type: ignore only under every condition recorded in python_typing_escape_hatches.

grounding.quote:
Python boundaries under this profile are checked with a strict static
typing pass such as `mypy --strict` or an equivalent strict checker
configuration. If the checker cannot run cleanly on the adopted boundary,
the boundary is not yet implementation-conformant under this profile (P1,
P6).

predicate.statement: Every function/method/callable has explicit parameter/return annotations; all semantic carriers are closed and typed, including tests/scripts/support code. Untyped def, implicit Any, semantic dict[str, Any]/Mapping[str, Any]/object carriers and unchecked multi-layer JSON interpreted through get chains are not typed semantic design. Parse/validate dynamic boundary input and narrow before transforms, keeping Any only at foreign boundaries and collapsing immediately. Run a strict static pass such as mypy --strict or equivalent; inability to run cleanly means not yet implementation-conformant.
predicate.uncertainty: A clean checker is necessary here, not a sufficient semantic acceptance claim.

conditions: Every new or materially changed active semantic boundary; before promoting changed/new entities, functions, authorities, effects, Prime carriers, modules, public operations or schemas.
exceptions: A wholly internal realization_refactor may cite the existing basis and prove no Ontology delta without reauthoring or reaccepting unchanged evidence.

grounding.quote:
Every new or materially changed active semantic boundary derives its
semantic model from one accepted Ontology (P1, P6;
rc.2 #4b-ontology-first-design-rule). Before a new or changed entity, function,
authority, effect, Prime-conformant carrier, module boundary, public
operation or schema is promoted, the affected boundary first produces a
candidate Ontology slice and carries it through the acceptance sequence
below.

predicate.statement: Derive from one accepted Ontology and first carry a candidate slice through acceptance. Acceptance identifies constitutional sources and accepting design authority, stable element/relation identities and version/basis making source changes, staleness and projection impacts decidable. Code, tests, generated schemas and a lone implementer cannot self-ratify missing authority. Materiality includes identity, authority, lifecycle, public contract, observable Product meaning, cross-module topology and accepted effect/closure law. Governing-source repricing invalidates only affected relations/projections pending impact reevaluation; semantic/structural changes publish only affected deltas and impact sets, and a changed digest alone does not freeze unrelated maintenance.
predicate.uncertainty: Detailed acceptance sequence and imported invalidators are not fully supplied.

exceptions: A disposable spike may supply evidence without selecting design.

grounding.quote:
Co-evolution is lawful only when `decision_complete(B)` holds:
design still owns the structural HOW, but design, implementation and tests
may evolve together and reconcile before promotion or closure.
Design-gated sequencing is required when implementation would otherwise
establish an unresolved or contradictory relation, or choose between
materially non-equivalent networks, with durable consequences for future
change: the affected design decision is accepted before retained
implementation establishes it. A disposable spike may supply evidence
without becoming the selected design.

predicate.statement: Co-evolution is lawful only with decision completeness, with design owning structural HOW and reconciliation before promotion/closure. If retained implementation would settle unresolved/contradictory relations or choose materially nonequivalent durable architecture, the affected design decision must be accepted first. Proportionality determines materiality and smallest affected gate. Reasoning-capacity-bounded symbolic contraction's removed code/runtime/test/review/reconciliation space is counterfactual evidence of contraction, not an independent reason for gating. A prior gate is warranted when material architectural ambiguity is removed with justified reasoning load; with no material alternative, separate acceptance adds no disambiguation. Design still owns and records HOW before promotion/closure.
predicate.uncertainty: The imported proportionality calculus is not supplied.

conditions: Implementation exposes ambiguity or repeated/cross-cutting material surprises.
exceptions: If accepted design is decision-complete and only realisation deviates, repair remains realization_refactor regardless of recurrence.

grounding.quote:
The bidirectional design-and-implementation relation is an evidence
relation, not bidirectional semantic authority. Implementation may provide
a counterexample, falsify a constraint or expose hidden ambiguity. It may
not select the missing semantic answer, rewrite upstream truth to legalise
itself, or ratify a material design decision after establishing it (P6).

predicate.statement: Implementation may counterexample/falsify/expose ambiguity but cannot supply missing semantic authority, legalize itself by rewriting upstream truth or ratify decisions after establishing them. Record sequencing and basis in existing carriers. Hidden architectural ambiguity switches the smallest causally closed affected decision set to gating without invalidating unrelated work. Serial repairs do not establish acceptance. Repeated surprises prompt diagnosis, not an automatic diagnosis; only diagnosis showing an underconstrained cut and failed decision completeness triggers one bounded design_reframe, with retained code provisional until its acceptance.
predicate.uncertainty: ACTIVATION diagnostic categories and SPEC_METHOD change classes are referenced, not fully defined here.

exceptions: Local algorithms/layout may remain open when every admitted choice is semantically equivalent under the accepted network.

grounding.quote:
Contradictory projections make the
design unsatisfiable and block promotion (P1, P5): an unsatisfiable design
fails the design gate's acceptance criterion, so this block is a
precondition of the gate (§7 Gate and retrospective work), not a decision
on a review finding.

predicate.statement: Readiness for retained implementation without prior gating is exactly decision completeness; a gate unable to establish it is not closed. Ontology, Prime contraction, IACS, target design, views, contracts, modules, implementation and tests project one network at different reasoning altitudes; their presence, names, plausibility or mechanical validity does not establish completeness. Failed decision completeness means underconstraint, including new implementation semantic choices, conflicting projections or admitted nonequivalent networks. Contradictory projections are unsatisfiable and block promotion as a gate precondition, not a review-finding disposition. Existing Ontology/algebra/mappings/views may express the network if jointly complete; another document is not required.
predicate.uncertainty: This describes the source predicate; it does not evaluate any boundary.

conditions: Every bounded local design action, relative to its affected governing frames.
exceptions: A subordinate frame opens only for a material distinction unresolved at the governing altitude; irrelevant descendants need not be recursively documented.

grounding.quote:
The result is evaluated against every affected governing frame, preserves
each applicable accepted relation, and updates only affected subordinate
projections. A bounded local action conserves governing truth; it does not
rewrite it. A result that changes a governing relation re-enters at that
relation before acceptance (P4b; FOUNDATIONS §3 P4b, frame instance). A
subordinate frame opens only when a material distinction cannot be
resolved at the governing altitude; this rule does not require recursively
documenting irrelevant descendants (P2). The law is false if a change is
locally valid inside the selected frame but violates, duplicates or
silently reinterprets an invariant in any affected governing frame.

predicate.statement: Evaluate against every affected governing frame, preserve applicable accepted relations and update only affected subordinate projections. Changing governing truth requires reentry at that relation before acceptance. Local validity does not excuse violating, duplicating or silently reinterpreting another affected frame invariant. The imported seam rule makes declared sets testable at declared seams without requiring a closure algorithm or irrelevant recursive expansion. Discovered verbs/screens/endpoints/commands/tickets/use cases are behavioural evidence, not direct architecture identities. Derivation order is constitutional functionality → candidate Ontology → logical completeness → whole-family Prime contraction → accepted Ontology → IACS → target design and domain/sequence/state projections → contracts/adapters → implementation/tests.
predicate.uncertainty: Imported seam semantics and subsequent Prime/design operations remain partially unresolved.

conditions: Selected substrate lacks any required native construction capability.

grounding.quote:
A missing
substrate capability remains an explicit design gap or triggers lawful
re-entry (SPEC_METHOD §4); it is not hidden behind a reference bridge,
adapter, filesystem runner, test double or promised future feature (P6;
SPEC_METHOD §7 Bridge prohibition).

predicate.statement: Semantic coherence does not make a design acceptable if its substrate cannot natively construct the required behaviour. Missing capability remains an explicit design gap or lawful reentry; bridges, adapters, filesystem runners, test doubles and future promises cannot conceal it.
predicate.uncertainty: The source prescribes no particular substrate or evidence mechanism.

conditions: Before constructing a material generic capability/common mechanic/algorithm or selecting a material dependency; recursively for material generic subproblems before retaining implementation.
exceptions: No package survey or ledger is required for a trivial helper unable materially to affect authority, Product behaviour, lifecycle cost or accepted design network.

grounding.quote:
Apply the pass proportionally. It
is mandatory for material algorithms, common mechanics, new dependencies
and locally rebuilt foundation capabilities. It does not require a package
survey or ledger for a trivial helper whose choice cannot materially affect
authority, Product behaviour, lifecycle cost or the accepted design network
(P2; ACTIVATION §6).

predicate.statement: Perform proportional prior selection, distinct from after-pattern recurrence extraction. First state capability without Product/domain/module/vendor/file/incumbent labels, then distinguish owned relations by owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis and material lifecycle/refusal invariants from supporting mechanics. This is relation/role factoring, not source-authorship factoring. Operate within the Product and already admitted migration strategy: do not choose evolution versus readoption or override SPEC_METHOD's rebuttable migration presumption. An incumbent may constrain migration candidates or start discovery, but selection has no source-order, familiarity, sunk-cost, local-code or dependency-count preference. Compare compositions, not merely packages.
predicate.uncertainty: The governing migration strategy and shared-machinery law are not supplied.

conditions: Every candidate category and every admitted material candidate.
exceptions: An immaterial residual may remain only with a reason it cannot change the current decision.

grounding.quote:
a category not searched records `not_applicable` or a named gap
with its reason. Discovery closes only for that declared basis and cutoff.
A discovery gap that could materially alter the frontier prevents
selection; an immaterial residual records why it cannot change the current
decision. A later candidate that satisfies the applicability criteria and
could materially alter the lawful frontier invalidates the affected
selection evidence and re-enters this relation (P6, P5, P3);

predicate.statement: Discovery must be bounded, reproducible and explicitly non-exhaustive. Per category record searched sources/collections, cutoff/version basis, applicability/inclusion criteria, material exclusions, predecessor/incumbent status, candidates and residual unknowns; unsearched categories need reasoned not_applicable or named gap. Material frontier-changing gaps prevent selection. Later applicable frontier-changing candidates invalidate affected evidence and trigger reentry. A ledger or equivalent compares all decision-changing dimensions: functional/constructability fit; semantic/operation-authority leakage; adapter/integration/migration/deletion/future-code costs; licence/maintenance/security/upgrade/supply chain; package/runtime/startup/storage/operations; determinism/concurrency/failure/recovery/reconstruction/replay; proof/assurance; exit/replacement/reversibility.
predicate.uncertainty: Discovery closure is bounded to its stated basis and cutoff, never exhaustive.

conditions: Current declared Product and evidence basis.
exceptions: A previously dominated candidate becomes selectable only if new evidence or another material dimension invalidates that dominance relation.

grounding.quote:
One lawful candidate composition dominates another on the current basis
only when every material decision dimension is comparable or evidenced as
non-discriminating between them, it is no worse on every comparable
dimension, and it is strictly better on at least one. A material unknown
that could reverse the relation prevents dominance and remains a gap. A
dominated candidate cannot be selected unless new evidence or another
material dimension invalidates the dominance relation; therefore a local
rebuild of generic mechanics is inadmissible when an existing lawful
foundation composition dominates it. Unused feature breadth alone does not
establish dominance and may itself add lifecycle cost (P2, P6).

predicate.statement: Hard authority, Product-contract, safety, security, licensing or native-constructability failure eliminates a candidate. Unknown stays unknown, never favourable scoring; no universal scalar is required. Dominance requires every material dimension comparable or evidenced nondiscriminating, no worse on all comparable dimensions and strictly better on at least one; a possibly reversing unknown prevents dominance. Dominated local rebuilding is inadmissible; unused features alone establish no dominance and may cost lifecycle effort. Existing trade-off owner selects only lawful undominated compositions using exact-Product/basis declared priorities and risk tolerances with recorded resolution; unresolved frontier remains design gap. Record decisive evidence/falsifier for rejected material candidates. Few dependencies, small edits, low lines or rich features do not themselves close selection; unsupported preference is not closure.
predicate.uncertainty: No candidate is selected or scored by this interpretation.

conditions: A foundation or composition realises an assigned semantic or authority-bearing role.

grounding.quote:
A selected foundation may realise
an explicitly assigned authority-bearing role when accepted design
preserves the declared relation's owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis
and material lifecycle and refusal invariants. Foundation capability,
provenance or source authorship cannot widen or remint that role.
Ownership belongs to the declared relation, not necessarily to locally
written code; an irreducible Product or domain relation retains its
declared owner whether local code, a reused foundation or their
composition realises it. Generic local code is lawful only when it wins
the same comparison; it is not the default (P6).

predicate.statement: Reuse automatically transfers no semantic, admission or operation authority. Accepted design may assign a foundation an authority-bearing role only while preserving declared owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis and material lifecycle/refusal invariants. Capability, provenance and source authorship cannot widen/remint authority; local versus reused implementation does not change relation ownership. Generic local code must win the same comparison and is not default.

conditions: Every entity and independently governed value family inside the active boundary.
exceptions: Subordinate Payloads/value objects inherit owner lifecycle and authority without peer rows unless they pass the Promotion Test.

grounding.quote:
Every cell identifies a lawful function,
declares `not_applicable` with a reason, or names a `Gap:` or
`Unanswered:` item and owner. Silence is not logical-completeness evidence
(P5, P6).

predicate.statement: Ontology enumerates entities, identities, relationships, cardinalities, invariants, lifecycle states and authority owners; evidence provides the matrix or equivalent closed representation. Each cell names lawful function, reasoned not_applicable or owned Gap:/Unanswered:, never silence. Create may mean declaration/construction/admission/materialisation; read should normally be a typed authoritative projection; update should normally be admitted transition/new version rather than semantic mutation; delete should normally retire/revoke/decommission/supersede where history/identity must remain true. These are completeness questions, not mutable-CRUD requirements.
predicate.uncertainty: The Promotion Test is not supplied.

conditions: Every Ontology function/lifecycle transition crossing semantic, authority, admission, effect, persistence or public boundary.
exceptions: A pure subordinate helper inherits its owning function's envelope without a peer authority row unless it crosses one of those boundaries.
One owner may hold multiple roles only with explicit governing-authority permission.

grounding.quote:
Composition does not widen authority implicitly: a composed or
higher-order function has no more authority than the authority law
admitted for its inputs, constituent functions and current basis.
Delegation, elevation, transfer or retirement authority requires a named
typed transition and an owning admission boundary; these carry in the
design the explicit authority decision that FOUNDATIONS requires and do not
replace it. Projections cannot create authority, and downstream code
cannot reconstruct an authority witness from actor labels, capability
strings or payload shape.

predicate.statement: Authority belongs in Ontology before operation shape, with a matrix or equivalent closed record for each qualifying transition. Role coincidence cannot be inferred from convenience. Composition/higher-order functions have no more authority than admitted for inputs, constituents and current basis. Delegation/elevation/transfer/retirement requires a named typed transition and owning admission boundary carrying, not replacing, the explicit authority decision. Projections create no authority and downstream code cannot reconstruct a witness from labels, capability strings or payload shape.
predicate.uncertainty: The complete imported list of non-authority-creating operations is not supplied.

conditions: Every consequential entity-transition domain and every material admission relation.
exceptions: Representative partial-failure observations may replace enumeration only with a declared dominance/equivalence proof covering the complete surface.
predicate.statement: Naming the admitter is insufficient: accepted design must declare the complete relation, including owners/supported boundaries; exact valid basis/predecessor/currentness continuity and coherent multi-owner bases; enclosing relation/participants/equality joins; refusal/effect boundaries; complete decomposable semantic commit and every material post-validation partial-publication boundary; reconstruction/direct/composite/nested forms; and competing-path disposition. Bind ACTIVATION §4's solely owned admission/standing-test semantics, instantiating qualification per owner and supported boundary. Missing or downstream-invented fields/owners/boundaries, implementation-inferred basis continuity/partial-failure coverage/reconstruction, and parser/helper/manufactured-refusal non-applicability falsify this obligation.
predicate.uncertainty: ACTIVATION §4 standing qualification is not reproduced; no qualification is performed here.

conditions: Same governed transition domain, entity identity, authority scope and predecessor basis.
exceptions: Disjoint scopes or identities are not counterexamples.
Equivalent paths may be lawful constituents, replicas, replacements or deliberately independent realisations when explicitly related to the singular law.

grounding.quote:
This law is false if any of the following holds (P6, P4b): two materially
non-equivalent admission relations remain reachable for the same governed
transition domain on the same entity identity, authority scope and
predecessor basis (disjoint scopes or identities are not a
counterexample); a materially equivalent competing implementation remains
reachable without being identified as a constituent, replica, replacement
or deliberately independent realisation; or a projection-triggered
reaction uses its own reconstructive state as self-authenticating
admission evidence.

predicate.statement: Two materially nonequivalent reachable admission laws on the same governed basis falsify singularity; an equivalent implementation also falsifies it if its relationship is undeclared. Competing-path disposition need not mean deletion, but retained superseded responsibility requires distinct supported purpose under core-interface migration, not just labels/tests. Projections may produce candidates but cannot admit by projection status; consequential results reenter the governing admission relation against explicit predecessor basis, and reconstructed state is never self-authenticating admission evidence.
predicate.uncertainty: Detailed migration retention law is external.

conditions: Higher-order algebra declarations apply where the boundary has higher-order behaviour.

grounding.quote:
Every row is one of: derived through an admitted atomic function; derived
through a declared higher-order composition; deferred with an owner and
re-entry condition; excluded by current product authority; or unresolved
as a named gap

predicate.statement: Derive the smallest parameterised atomic families making lifecycles logically complete. Variation only in entity kind, projection kind, transition kind, policy or subordinate payload should normally be a typed parameter or closed variant, not a peer function. The minimum derivation matrix uses all seven declared columns. Every functionality row is derived through an admitted atomic function, derived through declared composition, deferred with owner and re-entry condition, excluded by current Product authority, or unresolved as a named gap. For higher-order behaviour name the governing composition/effect algebra and applicable identity, closure, associativity, cardinality, effect and authority-conservation laws explicitly rather than hiding them in controller flow. No private helper, loop, adapter or endpoint may become an undeclared constructor.

conditions: Iterative discovery or retained implementation crosses an affected unresolved, contradictory or materially non-equivalent relation.
exceptions: Before design acceptance, a disposable spike may supply evidence when co_evolution_admissible(B) does not hold.

grounding.quote:
Composition, effects and implementation may be discovered iteratively only
when `co_evolution_admissible(B)` holds. Otherwise only a disposable spike
may supply evidence across the affected unresolved, contradictory or
materially non-equivalent relation before its design is accepted. Every
retained result is reconciled into accepted design before promotion or
design-method closure.

predicate.statement: Iterative discovery of composition, effects and implementation is permitted only under co_evolution_admissible(B). Otherwise the affected relation is design-gated before retained implementation establishes it. Every retained result must be reconciled into accepted design before promotion or design-method closure.
predicate.uncertainty: The full definition of co_evolution_admissible(B) is outside the supplied body sections.

exceptions: An out-of-domain case may justify proposing another candidate atom for design admission.

grounding.quote:
An atom without a declared admitted domain remains a candidate
atom; it cannot supply Prime acceptance or Prime-conformance to a
realisation projection.

predicate.statement: Smallness, typing, separate names or independent testability do not make a file, source function, class, schema record, public operation, diagram, module or owner category Prime. Many-to-many atom/unit mappings must be explicit and introduce no rival meaning or authority. An atomic function is not proven Prime until the complete candidate family is contracted. Every accepted atom declares its admitted domain and governs every admitted instance within it. Later use composes or parameterises it, never locally forks, shadows, specialises or reinterprets it. An in-domain counterexample falsifies the shared atom and requires re-entry at its design boundary, not a feature-local replacement. Without a declared domain it remains a candidate and supplies neither Prime acceptance nor projection Prime-conformance.

conditions: Before promotion; recurrence is contracted during design when visible.

grounding.quote:
A family of individually plausible functions is not Prime when one
parameterised template plus closed variants carries the same meaning and
authority. Recurrence is contracted during design when visible; the
post-implementation recurrence rule (§10) is not a substitute for this
prior pass

predicate.statement: Review includes every proposed identity, authority transition, lifecycle relation, topology, function, composition law, effect, closure law and every realisation projection. A function-and-carrier-only pass is insufficient. Review asks whether operations are parameters of one function, commands transitions of one entity, reads projections of one truth, implementations applications of one higher-order function; whether candidates add independent identity, authority, effect, lifecycle, reuse or public pattern-match semantics; whether every atom kind entered contraction; whether every unit maps explicitly to accepted atoms; and whether projections introduce, duplicate or reinterpret meaning or authority. Individually plausible functions fail family Prime when one parameterised template with closed variants carries the same meaning and authority.

conditions: At a material semantic boundary.
exceptions: Work inside an accepted boundary cites the existing Prime basis rather than recreating it.

| preserves | leaves the relation intact and operates inside it | `satisfied` |
| changes | alters the relation itself, and therefore re-enters at that relation before acceptance | `invalid_basis` |

| violates | contradicts the relation, or establishes an equivalent path that is left undisposed | `falsified` |

Insufficient admissible evidence yields indeterminate with what would decide; insufficiency specifically of the selected method/design falsifies reconstruction sufficiency. value.definition: Foundation-to-law family for transitions, steps and configuration, covering sections 1 and 4. These instance premises condition its governed work, are not commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone. The table identifies P0 as recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 as independent; P4b as derived from P0 and P2 with the non-reacquirability premise; and P5 as derived from P0 and P6 with the open-world premise.

grounding.quote:
Foundation to law. This family, transitions, steps and configuration,
covers this section and §4. Its instance premises are: (a) a selected
outcome with its acceptance conditions; (b) work that may exceed one
activation's capacity; (c) actors with declared capability envelopes; (d)
an admitted grant. They are conditions of the work this family governs,
not commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone. The
standing of the consequences below is stated in
[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law).

The destination is defined by constraints: the selected outcome with its

grounding.quote:
A transition is a bounded change from the current state to a next state,
carried out by one step. Where the work exceeds one activation's capacity,
the outer transformation towards the destination is refined into a series
of bounded transitions under §4 Refinement, each carried out by its own
step; work that fits one activation is a single transition. Each
transition binds the obligations it must preserve: the outer obligations
of the destination and of the governing relations it affects, as far as
they apply to it.

This subsection states the construction relation for this corpus: how a
selected construction binds its current state and destination, chooses
its work, composes its steps, corrects itself and claims completion. It
is law carried from the common construction requirement and the universal
construction model of the Product that owns this corpus, restated here at
its owner. ACTIVATION §2 to §7, EVALUATION §1, SPEC_METHOD §4 and §8,
EXECUTIVE_BASELINE, ODD and the other consumers named in the design
apply it; none restates it (P6).

value.label: Construction relation

value.definition: Three distinct subject accounts: specification is the internal reference model of required conditions; observations describe what holds; causal or predictive models explain how action may change state. These are distinct from FOUNDATIONS' accounts of a construction.

grounding.quote:
Three accounts of the subject, distinct from the accounts of a
construction ([FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#accounts-of-a-construction)).
The specification is the internal reference model of the required
conditions. Observations describe what does hold. A causal or
predictive model explains how an action may change the state. These
accounts have different purposes and can be incomplete or wrong in
different ways; a claim about one is never taken for a claim about
another, and the applicability and adequacy of a predictive model are
claims of their own (P1).

value.label: Specification, observation and predictive accounts
